issues.finding: Homepage EducationalOrganization schema asserts accreditedBy DGCA. The Credentials page also claims DGCA accreditation/approval, but the reviewed business facts do not contain an approval type, certificate number, or primary-source evidence.
issues.visibleContent: The homepage calls the academy a DGCA pilot training institute; /credentials says DGCA approval status/accreditation is verified.
issues.assessment: The schema and visible entity claim are not substantiated by the verified business facts supplied for this audit.

issues.finding: Course schema emits AggregateOffer lowPrice 1500000/highPrice 2500000 INR. The same ₹15-25 lakh band is visible on-page, but no primary source or matching verified fee fact exists in the project.
issues.otherCourseData: Schema also says timeRequired P36M and a blended CourseInstance at Dwarka; visible copy describes ATPL progression as commonly three years or more, but does not establish a current academy course duration or current fee.

issues.finding: Four CourseInstance nodes contain timeRequired: null. Their duration inputs use PT2M/PT3M while the shared duration parser expects month strings and returns null.
issues.assessment: JSON is parseable, but null is not a meaningful course duration and the intended duration semantics are unclear.

issues.finding: The homepage course-provider nodes use sameAs equal to the site's own URL, while credentials declares LinkedIn company/weoneaviation and the Footer links to company/we-one-aviation/. The global Organization schema does not use a consistent social-profile set.
issues.assessment: Conflicting or self-referential sameAs signals do not reliably identify the verified social entity.

issues.finding: Homepage Organization schema includes geo coordinates 28.5921, 77.0460. The current business-entity audit records the Maps CID coordinate as 28.5851865, 77.071156 and explicitly says the live pin/address match still needs verification.
issues.assessment: The schema point and recorded Maps CID point differ; the published street address itself is consistent.

issues.finding: Service schema declares areaServed Country India and an Offer price of 0. The project verifies online batches for students outside Delhi, but does not independently verify nationwide counselling availability or a no-obligation free counselling offer.
issues.assessment: Schema scope and price claims go beyond the verified business facts.

issues.finding: The PPL CourseInstance schema names Dwarka, New Delhi as its location. The project's business facts verify the Dwarka classroom and PPL guidance, but flight training is arranged at selected FTOs elsewhere.
issues.assessment: The schema does not itself distinguish classroom/theory delivery from the flying stage.

seoRisks.evidence: pages/index.jsx marks DGCA as accreditedBy; pages/credentials.jsx states fully DGCA-approved/accredited. Reviewed business facts contain no approval type, certificate number, or primary-source proof.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: An unsubstantiated regulator approval/accreditation claim changes the academy's apparent legal and business status and is repeated in visible copy and structured data.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Obtain and verify the exact DGCA approval scope and certificate/reference, or remove the claim if it cannot be substantiated.

seoRisks.evidence: pages/courses/atpl.jsx publishes a ₹15-25 lakh range and schema AggregateOffer ₹1,500,000-₹2,500,000 without a verified project fee source. Homepage course schema emits durations such as 18-24 months and 6-12 months; the visible homepage also contains international training fees, durations, simulator/job-placement claims, and scholarship/loan assistance. These claims are not present in the verified business facts and conflict with pages that say terms vary or are unpublished.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: Students may rely on unverified price, duration, training-facility, placement, scholarship, or loan claims when making high-cost decisions; schema can surface the price as a structured offer.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Verify each currently visible course-specific figure/offer against current primary business terms and remove unsupported claims from visible content and schema.

seoRisks.evidence: The /pilot-career-counselling Service schema sets areaServed to Country India and Offer price to 0. Verified business facts support online batches outside Delhi, but do not establish India-wide counselling coverage or a free/no-obligation counselling offer.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: This expands stated service coverage and commercial terms beyond documented facts and creates a conflicting nationwide entity signal.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Confirm counselling coverage and price with the business owner; retain schema only for verified terms.

seoRisks.evidence: /blogs/1, /blogs/2, /blogs/5 and /blogs/6 are index, follow, have canonicals to other pages, and still appear in the 112-URL sitemap.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: The sitemap promotes URLs that each page's canonical tells crawlers are not the preferred version. /blogs/6 also contradicts the blog index comment that it is noindexed.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Align sitemap eligibility with canonical targets and verify legacy post indexing/canonical handling.

seoRisks.evidence: LocalitySearchPage always sets noindex, follow, while generate-sitemap.js includes locality canonical paths marked PUBLISH_INDEXABLE/status publish. Input is currently empty, so no affected URL exists today.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: If locality records are ever enabled, a generated noindex page could also be advertised in the sitemap.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Before any future locality publication, make route robots state and sitemap eligibility use the same publication policy.

seoRisks.evidence: Homepage schema uses sameAs equal to the academy's own website; footer and credentials use different LinkedIn company URL slugs. Homepage schema geo coordinates 28.5921, 77.0460 differ from the Maps CID coordinates recorded in business-entity-audit.json (28.5851865, 77.071156); the audit itself says the pin needs verification.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: Search systems may receive conflicting social entity identifiers and location points even though the written street address agrees.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Verify the canonical social profile URL and academy map pin, then align entity schema to those verified references.

seoRisks.evidence: /dgca-ground-classes and /dgca-ground-classes-in-india are both indexable, self-canonical, sitemap-listed, and describe the same Dwarka classroom plus online availability outside Delhi.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: The near-identical offer and national phrasing can divide relevance between two pages without adding a verified second delivery location.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Clarify their separate search intent and unique user value; consolidate only if the business accepts that content decision.

seoRisks.evidence: pages/courses.jsx links the anchors 'pilot training in Mumbai', 'pilot training in Bangalore', and 'pilot training in Chhattisgarh' to /pilot-training-in-india while promising location-specific advice and schedules. public/llms.txt describes class options 'across India' and a roughly six-month duration.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: The anchors and scope phrasing can imply locality-specific schedules or nationwide physical delivery that the linked national hub and verified facts do not establish.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Align anchors and machine-readable summary copy with the actual single classroom plus online access outside Delhi.

seoRisks.evidence: /doubt returns 200, has a self-canonical and is listed in the sitemap, but its built HTML has no robots meta.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: A form/utility route is implicitly indexable; this may be intentional, but no explicit indexing decision is recorded.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Confirm whether the public utility page is intended as a search landing page; set indexing and sitemap policy accordingly.

seoRisks.evidence: scripts/validate-local-search.js fails its link expectation because Delhi, Dwarka and DGCA Ground Classes do not link to /pilot-training-near. They instead link to the indexable national hub and relevant Delhi/Dwarka/course authorities.
seoRisks.whyItMatters: There is no SEO harm in not linking to a noindex hub; the assertion is a validator-policy mismatch, not a production linking defect.
seoRisks.recommendedNextAction: Review the validator's expectation separately from production routing; do not add near-hub links solely to satisfy it.
